Our planet is experiencing an increase in global temperatures that will greatly harm our quality of life.
Rising temperatures are caused by human activities that emit greenhouse gases, like carbon dioxide and methane, which trap heat in the atmosphere and warm the earth’s climate.
Failure to address these issues will threaten human life on earth within the next century.
